preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 2 and 300,000.
The string s has a length exactly equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> (1 <= l < r <= n and 1 <= l < r <= n)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then l and r are valid indices within the string bounds.
If the output is 'NO', then there is no valid substring to reverse.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> any(s[l-1:r] == s[l-1:r][::-1] for l, r in possible_substrings)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then there exists a substring that, when reversed, makes the string lexicographically less.
